# SAMAN Portable

SAMAN Portable is the public website of SAMAN POS India Private Limited.

Business description: factory-built portable and prefabricated structures for commercial, industrial, site, and infrastructure use in India.

Main product categories:
- Portable cabins and porta cabins
- Container offices and portable office cabins
- Container cafes and container houses
- Prefabricated houses and prefab buildings
- Industrial sheds, PEB construction, and pre-engineered buildings
- Security cabins, portable toilets, and labour colony units

Website: https://www.samanportable.com
Sitemap: https://www.samanportable.com/sitemap.xml
Contact email: sales@samanportable.com
